name: Sunburst2 Deluxe ECU (Lua Power)
author: Kristof
description: Deluxe ECU for the Sunburst with a Lua-based power multiplier, custom idle/rev-limiter, soft-damage simulation with toggleable indestructible mode, three VGT turbo tunes, three transmission options (15-speed manual, 6-speed sequential, 8-speed auto), an optional big-block 6.2L torque-curve remap, an in-game tuning app, and backfire/BOV sound hooks.
